description: Establish a green baseline before any changes. Install deps, build in order, run all unit + property + e2e + synth suites, and confirm they pass. This de-risks later features by proving the toolchain path and current test state.
steps: Prepend PATH="/opt/toolchains/.nvm/versions/node/v22.23.3/bin:$PATH" to every npm command (npm is not on PATH by default in this sandbox).
From repo root run: npm install (workspaces already populated; confirms lockfile is consistent).
Run: npm run build  (ordered shared -> backend -> frontend -> infra) and confirm it exits 0.
Run: npm test  (vitest across shared/backend/frontend/infra, including fast-check *.property.test.ts) and confirm all pass.

Run: npm run test:e2e -w @mlb/frontend  (Playwright headless chromium). If the Playwright browser is not installed, run `npx playwright install chromium` first. Confirm the existing home.spec.ts and prediction.spec.ts pass.
Run: npm run synth  and confirm cdk synth produces a template with no errors (nodejs20.x deprecation WARNINGs are acceptable, they already appear in the baseline).
Record the baseline results in this feature's findings field.
acceptance_criteria: npm test passes for all four workspaces.
npm run test:e2e -w @mlb/frontend passes (all existing specs).
findings:
